description: Compare two texts side by side and see every word added, removed or unchanged.

faqs.a: Words are compared with the longest-common-subsequence algorithm, so matching words are aligned even when large blocks move around.
The cap keeps the diff fast — a 5,000-word-per-side comparison already fills 25 million table cells in memory. Compare larger texts in smaller chunks.
faqs.q: Why is there a 5,000-word limit per text?

faqs.a: No. The diff runs entirely in your browser; your texts never leave your device.

howto: Paste the original text into the first box and the revised text into the second.
Added words are highlighted green, removed words red, unchanged words stay plain.
Check the summary for the count of added, removed and unchanged words.
title: Text Diff Checker
